title: Containers and Compose
description: Packaging the back end and front end as container images and running them together: images versus containers with Docker and Podman, image layers and build caching, multi-stage builds, ports, volumes and environment variables, a Compose stack for the Spring Boot service and its database, service-name networking, start order with health checks, and debugging with logs and exec.
sourceCoverageNotes: Course slice: Standard week 8, S36-S39 (curriculum/snapshot/pep-curriculum.json /tracks/1/weeks/7/days/0..3) and Fast week 5, FT21-FT23 (/tracks/2/weeks/4/days/0..2). This module covers S36 rows 0-3 and S37 rows 0-3, which Fast packs into FT21 rows 0-6 and FT22 row 0.

Module grouping is a second-mate intake decision, not syllabus (closes source-gap-containers-cicd-modules): modules follow calendar day sequence, S36-S37 here and S38-S39 in microservices-and-ci-cd, which matches Fast day FT21 = S36+S37.

Fast wording variants map to one canonical topic each: 'Multi-stage builds: back-end and front-end images' to multi-stage-builds, 'Health checks and depends_on' (FT22 row 0) to depends-on-with-health-checks, and the '(skim)' rows for image layers and debugging to their Standard topics; skim is track emphasis, not a separate page.

Planned module coding lab containers-cicd/containers-and-compose/coding-lab (Standard S36-S37 lab overlay; Fast does not require it) is authored in this module's PR; moduleLabs lists it once it exists. See evidence/containers-cicd/intake.md, section Lab plan.
